whenToUse: Choosing a brand, label, campaign or chart series colour.
Offering a curated swatch palette with an optional custom value.
avoidWhen: Theming the app itself — set data-accent or --accent-base instead of a free colour.
Status colours — use the semantic tones (success, warning, danger).
a11y: The saturation area and hue strip are keyboard sliders with value text.
Show the hex value as text and warn on poor contrast against the surface.
